summary: Acer Predator Helios Neo 16 (2024 model), Intel Core i7-13700HX, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060, 8GB DDR5 RAM, 16GB DDR5 RAM, 1TB SSD, 240Hz QXGA display. Prone to thermal throttling and high CPU temperatures during gaming and loading menus.
detected_fault: Thermal paste application issues and BIOS limitations on undervolting contribute to overheating.
suggested_solution: Replace thermal paste, use cooling pads or alternative cooling solutions, optimize BIOS settings and software tools for temperature management.
